answer: Make every seat post a live concentrated-liquidity position in the protocol's own pool, each bound to a distinct ownership token. Unlike idle copper locked in a vault, this capital bleeds loss-versus-rebalancing to arbitrageurs on every price move, a steady plume of value leaking out while the seat is held. A raven-flock of 500 clones must fund and bleed 500 separate positions, since one position backs only one token, while an honest agent carries one. Pulling the capital to recycle it instantly vacates the seat, so the cost is recurring and linear in identity count, not a reclaimable deposit.
